# FOOD LINE

> FOOD LINE  is a China-based manufacturer of automatic packing machines and turnkey packaging lines for powder, granules, liquids/pastes and solid products. Free sample testing, voltage built to the buyer's country, installation and training worldwide. Contact: WhatsApp +86 183 3929 5069.

## How to request a quote
Provide: product and its form; weight/volume per pack; required speed; pack type and size; voltage/phase/frequency. Reply within 24 hours.
- [Contact & quote](https://www.allfoodmach.com/contact/)

## Product categories
- [Multi-Lane Sachet & Stick Pack Machines](https://www.allfoodmach.com/products/multi-lane-sachet-stick-pack-machines/): 2 to 16 lanes running in parallel for small sachets and stick packs of powder, granules, liquid and paste — 3-side, 4-side or back seal.
- [Vertical Form Fill Seal (VFFS) Packing Machines](https://www.allfoodmach.com/products/vertical-form-fill-seal-machines/): Bags made from roll film: pillow, gusset, stand-up and hanging-hole bags from 30 g to 5 kg+, matched with a multihead weigher, auger filler, cup filler or liquid pump.
- [Premade Pouch (Rotary Doypack) Packing Machines](https://www.allfoodmach.com/products/premade-pouch-packing-machines/): 8-station and 6-station rotary machines that pick, open, fill, seal and discharge zipper, stand-up, flat-bottom and spout pouches.
- [Horizontal Flow Wrap (Pillow) Packing Machines](https://www.allfoodmach.com/products/flow-wrap-pillow-packing-machines/): Horizontal pillow packing for bread, cakes, biscuits, candy bars, ice-lollies, hardware and medical items, up to 230 packs/min.
- [Bottle & Jar Filling and Capping Lines](https://www.allfoodmach.com/products/filling-capping-lines/): Turnkey liquid, sauce, powder and granule filling lines for bottles, jars and cans: unscrambler, filler, capper, labeller and collection table.
- [Bulk Bagging Lines & Auxiliary Equipment](https://www.allfoodmach.com/products/weighing-bagging-auxiliary-equipment/): 20–30 kg open-mouth bagging lines plus weighers, conveyors, check weighers, metal detectors, coders, air compressors and nitrogen generators.

## Applications
- [Powder Packing Solutions](https://www.allfoodmach.com/applications/powder-packing-solutions/): Milk powder, flour, coffee, spices, protein, starch, detergent and chemical powders — from 1 g sticks to 5 kg bags.
- [Snack, Nut & Granule Packing Solutions](https://www.allfoodmach.com/applications/snack-granule-packing-solutions/): Chips, puffed food, nuts, seeds, candy, dried fruit, rice, beans, sugar and pet food.
- [Liquid, Sauce & Paste Packing Solutions](https://www.allfoodmach.com/applications/liquid-sauce-packing-solutions/): Ketchup, chilli sauce, honey, jam, edible oil, vinegar, juice, shampoo, lotions and liquid detergent.
- [Bakery, Candy & Solid Product Packing](https://www.allfoodmach.com/applications/bakery-candy-flow-wrap-solutions/): Bread, cake, biscuits, mooncakes, candy and chocolate bars, ice lollies, soap, masks, medical and hardware items.
- [Frozen Food Packing Solutions](https://www.allfoodmach.com/applications/frozen-food-packing-solutions/): Frozen dumplings, wontons, meatballs, shrimp, vegetables and ice cubes.
- [Coffee, Milk Tea & Sugar Stick Packing Machines](https://www.allfoodmach.com/applications/coffee-milk-tea-stick-packing-solutions/): Single-serve sticks and sachets of instant coffee, 3-in-1 coffee, milk tea, creamer, sugar, cocoa and solid drinks.
- [Spice & Seasoning Powder Packing Machines](https://www.allfoodmach.com/applications/spice-seasoning-powder-packing-solutions/): Chilli powder, curry, black pepper, masala, cumin, garlic powder, chicken and noodle seasoning.
- [Potato Chips & Puffed Snack Packing Machines](https://www.allfoodmach.com/applications/chips-snack-packing-solutions/): Potato chips, corn chips, puffed snacks, popcorn, extruded snacks, crackers and nuts.

## Guides
- [How Much Does a Packing Machine Cost? 7 Factors That Set the Price](https://www.allfoodmach.com/blog/packing-machine-price-factors/): A packing machine's price is set mainly by the dosing system your product needs, the speed (number of lanes or bags per minute), the pack format, the automation around the machine, contact materials and options such as nitrogen flushing or check weighing.
- [How to Choose the Right Packing Machine: A 5-Step Buyer's Guide](https://www.allfoodmach.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-packing-machine/): Choose a packing machine by answering five questions in order: what the product is, how much goes in each pack, how many packs per minute, what pack format, and what your site can supply (power, air, space).
- [VFFS vs Premade Pouch Packing Machine: Which Should You Buy?](https://www.allfoodmach.com/blog/vffs-vs-premade-pouch-packing-machine/): Choose VFFS for the lowest packaging cost and highest speed with pillow or gusset bags; choose a premade-pouch machine when you need zipper, flat-bottom or spout pouches and a premium retail look.
- [Multi-Lane Stick Pack Machines: Lanes, Speed & Output Explained](https://www.allfoodmach.com/blog/multi-lane-stick-pack-machine-guide/): Output of a multi-lane machine = number of lanes × 20–40 cuts per minute. Pick the number of lanes from your daily target, then the seal style and dosing system from your product.
